description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ProviderStartException' used in the Orleans framework, specifically related to streaming providers. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and serialization support.

classes.name: ProviderStartException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating failure to start a streaming provider within Orleans. It extends OrleansException and supports serialization.

methods.name: ProviderStartException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor with a message and inner exception.
